Account.title: Account
Account.lede: Changes save automatically when you leave a field.
Account.name: Name
Account.contactHint: We use it for exam reminders and invoices

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.notificationsHint: WhatsApp and email, with a switch for each type
Settings.invoicesHint: Your payment history with VAT shown separately
Settings.dataHint: Download your data or delete your account

Study.title: Study preferences
Study.lede: Defaults for each new session — you can change all of them during the explanation.
Study.timeEffect: “In a hurry” gives you a shorter explanation focused on what matters most. “I have time” explains at a steady pace with examples and checks your understanding. Applies from your next session.
Study.speedEffect: Explanations currently use one speed. This option will be enabled when sessions support speed changes.
Study.formatEffect: Sets the format of questions you answer after each topic. You can choose a different format for each course on its page.
Study.recordingsEffect: Off by default: your voice recordings are deleted within 24 hours of the session ending. Turn it on to keep them for 30 days and listen from the session page.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.lede: Each type has its own switch. There’s no single switch that turns everything off.
Notifications.examEffect: Arrives one week and two days before your exam, with the chapters you still need to finish.
Notifications.readyEffect: Arrives when a course you requested becomes available.
Notifications.quotaEffect: Alerts you in the app when less than 20% of your monthly minutes remain. We don’t send it by WhatsApp or email.
Notifications.billingAlways: Invoices and payment confirmations are always sent. They concern your money, so they stay on.

Data.title: Your data
Data.lede: Your data is yours. Download or delete it whenever you want.
Data.downloadBody: One file with your sessions, progress in each course, questions and answers, exam dates and account details. In a format you can open in any spreadsheet.
Data.requested: We’re preparing your file. A download link will reach your email within an hour. The link works for 7 days.
Data.deleteBody: Deletion is permanent. Before you decide, the next page explains exactly what’s deleted, what’s kept and how long it takes.

Delete.title: Delete account
Delete.lede: Read both sections below before deciding. Deletion can’t be undone.
Delete.deletedAccount: Your account, name, email and phone number.
Delete.deletedSessions: All your sessions: what Becan explained, your questions and answers, and where you struggled.
Delete.deletedProgress: Your progress in each course and your saved exam dates.
Delete.deletedAudio: Any voice recordings we still have for you.
Delete.keptInvoices: Your invoices and payment amounts — tax regulations require us to keep them. They contain no study content.
Delete.keptStats: Aggregated statistics that can’t be traced back to you or identify you, such as how many students studied a particular chapter.
Delete.whenBody: Your account closes as soon as you confirm the request. You can’t sign in after that. Your data is deleted from our systems within 30 days. During the first 7 days, you can cancel using the link we email you.
Delete.receivedBody: Your account is now closed, and your data will be deleted within 30 days. We’ve emailed you confirmation with a link to cancel within 7 days if you change your mind.
Delete.phraseInvalid: Type “{phrase}” exactly to confirm this is intentional
Delete.activeSubscription: You have a paid subscription active until {date}. Deleting your account stops it now, and we don’t refund the remaining period. Canceling without deleting lets you use it until the end.

Invoices.title: Invoices
Invoices.lede: Every payment you’ve made, with VAT separate from the net amount.
Invoices.emptyBody: Your first invoice appears here after your first paid subscription.
Invoices.caption: Your invoice history
Invoices.note: All amounts are in Saudi riyals and include VAT. Need an invoice in an organization’s name? <contact>Contact us</contact>.

Subscription.confirmTitle: Canceling returns you to the free plan
Subscription.cancelBody: You can cancel renewal anytime. Your plan stays active until the end of your paid period.
Subscription.canceledBody: Your {plan} plan stays active until {date}, then you return to the free plan. You won’t be charged.
Subscription.vatNote: The price includes VAT. See the breakdown in <invoices>your invoices</invoices>.

Error.title: The page didn’t open
Error.body: Something stopped on our end while loading the page. Your device and connection are fine, and your progress is safe.
Error.help: Keeps happening? <contact>Contact us</contact> and check the <status>system status</status>.
Error.digest: If you contact us, include this code so we can find the error log: {digest}

NotFound.title: This page isn’t here
NotFound.body: The link may be old, or a character is missing from the address.

Maintenance.title: Becan is under maintenance
Maintenance.body: We’re updating the servers that run voice explanations. The service is paused during the update. Your account, minutes and subscription are unaffected.
Maintenance.backLabel: We expect to be back at
Maintenance.backIn: About an hour and a half from now.
Maintenance.contact: Contact us if you need help now

Status.title: System status
Status.checked: Last checked: 23 August 2026 · 4:20 PM · We check every minute.
Status.historyBody: What happened, how long it lasted, and what we did to prevent it from happening again.
Status.report: See a problem that isn’t listed here? <contact>Let us know</contact> — your report helps us start investigating.

partial.label: Partially affected
partial.note: Some parts of the service are slower than usual or unavailable.

down.label: Unavailable
down.note: The service is down. We’re working on it.

voice.title: Voice explanations interrupted
voice.what: An update failed at our audio processing provider. You could resume affected sessions from the same topic, and those minutes weren’t deducted.

slides.title: Slides slow to open
slides.what: The file server was overloaded during final exams. We increased capacity and added a limit to prevent it from happening again.

maintenance.title: Scheduled maintenance
maintenance.what: A server update, announced two days in advance.

Checkout.title: Checkout
Checkout.expiryInvalid: Enter the month and year — for example, 09/28
Checkout.monthInvalid: The month must be between 01 and 12
Checkout.cvcInvalid: The security code is 3 digits on the back of your card
Checkout.nameRequired: Enter the name as it appears on your card
Checkout.name: Name on card
Checkout.phonePayment: Complete payment from your phone without entering any numbers.
Checkout.security: Payment goes through an approved payment gateway. Becan doesn’t store your card number. Your subscription renews monthly, and you can cancel anytime.

Result.declinedFix: Contact your bank or try another card — your bank declined it, not Becan.
Result.fundsWhy: Your balance doesn’t cover the amount.
Result.fundsFix: Add funds or try another payment method. Your plan stays reserved for you.
Result.expiredFix: Use a valid card, or pay from your phone without entering numbers.
Result.onlineWhy: Online purchases aren’t enabled on your card.
Result.onlineFix: Enable them in your bank’s app — usually under “Card settings” — then try again.
Result.unchanged: You haven’t been charged, and your plan hasn’t changed.
Result.pendingBody: Your bank is reviewing the payment. This takes a few minutes. We’ll notify you on WhatsApp and by email when it’s complete. You don’t need to try again.
Result.pendingDefault: Your current plan’s minutes are still available. You can study with them while payment is being processed.
Result.successBody: You’re on the {plan} plan — {minutes, plural, one {{minutesLabel} minute} other {{minutesLabel} minutes}} a month, with all your courses unlocked. Your invoice has been emailed to you.
Result.help: Happening again? <contact>Message us on WhatsApp</contact> and we’ll help you follow it up.
Result.pendingResume: Your current plan’s minutes are still available. You can continue {course} — Chapter {number} while payment is being processed.
